description: This file defines a protocol for background synchronization scheduling, providing an abstract interface and a no-operation fallback implementation to ensure app functionality even when background sync is unavailable.

classes.name: NoopBackgroundSyncScheduler
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the BackgroundSyncScheduling protocol that performs no actions, used when background scheduling is unavailable.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Prepares system hooks for background scheduling; intended to be called during app startup.

methods.name: schedulePeriodicSync
methods.description: Requests or refreshes a periodic background sync, with an optional earliest start time.
